name: v2.8 29 LI: two purposes render on two marked SO- workflows, the player's selection is untouched

steps.eval: const ctx=SillyTavern.getContext(); const sd=ctx.extensionSettings.sd; const img=globalThis.storyOrchestratorImage; const post=(route,body)=>fetch('/api/sd/comfy/'+route,{method:'POST',headers:ctx.getRequestHeaders(),body:JSON.stringify(body)}); const listed=await (await post('workflows',{url:sd.comfy_url})).json(); const sourceName='WAI_Illustrious_v17.json'; if(!listed.includes(sourceName)) throw Error('source workflow missing'); const base=JSON.parse(await (await post('workflow',{file_name:sourceName})).json()); const made={}; for(const [name,prefix] of [['SO-LI-A.json','SO_LI_A'],['SO-LI-B.json','SO_LI_B']]){   if(listed.includes(name)) throw Error(name+' already exists');   const graph=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(base)); graph['5'].inputs.steps=10; graph['7'].inputs.filename_prefix=prefix;   const saved=await post('save-workflow',{file_name:name,workflow:JSON.stringify(graph,null,2)}); if(!saved.ok) throw Error('save '+name+' '+saved.status); made[name]=prefix; } globalThis.__so29={selected:sd.comfy_workflow, made, imageSettings:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(img.settings())), listedBefore:listed}; img.updateSettings({enabled:true, backend:'st', automation:{mode:'off', everyN:5}}); return {selected:sd.comfy_workflow, made, source:sd.source};

import_story.title: SO LI story workflows
import_story.description: Maps two picture purposes to two marked ST workflows.

steps.eval: const ctx=SillyTavern.getContext(); const sd=ctx.extensionSettings.sd; const img=globalThis.storyOrchestratorImage; const s=globalThis.__so29; const out=[]; for(const purpose of ['scene','background','character']){   const plan=await img.plan({purpose,text:'an old stone hall with a fireplace, warm light',messageId:null,raw:true});   const began=Date.now();   const path=await img.direct({purpose,text:'an old stone hall with a fireplace, warm light',messageId:null,raw:true});   out.push({purpose, plannedWorkflow:plan.workflow, rendered:Boolean(path), ms:Date.now()-began, selectedAfter:sd.comfy_workflow, note:img.status().workflowNote}); } globalThis.__so29.out=out; return out;

const sd=SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings.sd; const s=globalThis.__so29; const byPurpose=Object.fromEntries(s.out.map((row)=>[row.purpose,row])); const floors={scenePlannedOnA:byPurpose.scene.plannedWorkflow==='SO-LI-A.json', backgroundPlannedOnB:byPurpose.background.plannedWorkflow==='SO-LI-B.json', unmappedUsesSelection:byPurpose.character.plannedWorkflow===null, selectionUnchangedInMemory:s.out.every((row)=>row.selectedAfter===s.selected) && sd.comfy_workflow===s.selected, allRendered:s.out.every((row)=>row.rendered)}; return {floors, ok:Object.values(floors).every(Boolean), rows:s.out.map((row)=>({purpose:row.purpose, planned:row.plannedWorkflow, ms:row.ms, note:row.note}))};

const ctx=SillyTavern.getContext(); const sd=ctx.extensionSettings.sd; const img=globalThis.storyOrchestratorImage; const s=globalThis.__so29; const post=(route,body)=>fetch('/api/sd/comfy/'+route,{method:'POST',headers:ctx.getRequestHeaders(),body:JSON.stringify(body)}); const removed=[]; for(const name of Object.keys(s.made)){ if(!/^SO-LI-[AB]\.json$/.test(name)) continue; const response=await post('delete-workflow',{file_name:name}); removed.push({name,status:response.status}); } const listed=await (await post('workflows',{url:sd.comfy_url})).json(); img.updateSettings(s.imageSettings); return {removed, leaked:listed.filter((name)=>/^SO-LI-/.test(name)), listedSame:JSON.stringify([...listed].sort())===JSON.stringify([...s.listedBefore].sort())};
